title: FlowDesk
description: A modern offline-first productivity application for managing tasks, notes, goals, and habits in one responsive workspace.
longDescription: FlowDesk is a productivity-focused web application that combines task management, notes, goals, and habit tracking in one clean interface. The project focuses on responsive design, local-first functionality, intuitive navigation, and an application-style user experience.
features: Task, note, goal, and habit management
Search, filtering, sorting, priorities, tags, and due dates
challenges: Organizing several productivity tools without overwhelming the interface
Creating reusable UI patterns across multiple application areas
Maintaining usability across desktop and mobile layouts
results: Created a unified productivity application architecture
Designed the project around local persistence and offline usability

Built reusable transaction and summary components
